title: room.created
description: server → host. Confirms the new room and gives the host everything it shows on the title screen. The host renders joinUrl as the QR code.

hostToken.description: Host reconnect token. The host must persist it (PlayerPrefs / localStorage) so a refresh can `room.resume`.

joinUrl.description: Player join URL and QR content: `<clientBaseUrl>?room=<CODE>`.

spectateUrl.description: Audience join URL and QR content: `<clientBaseUrl>?room=<CODE>&watch=1`.

slotHoldMs.description: How long a disconnected player keeps slot and roles. Always 180000 (3 min).

roomHoldMs.description: How long the room survives without its host. Always 600000 (10 min).

RoomCode.description: Room code: exactly 4 upper-case letters from A–Z without I and O (24-letter alphabet). Clients upper-case user input before sending.

Token.description: Opaque reconnect token issued by the server (URL-safe, 16–64 characters). Stored in the browser sessionStorage (phones) or host persistent storage. Never shown on screen.
